name: 07524 · Paterson, NJ
findings: ZIP 07524 (Paterson) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07524 (Paterson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
